# Royal PMS

Royal PMS is a web-based hotel management platform for independent hotels, inns, corporate hotels and local hotel groups.

Public product pages live under:
- https://royal.app.br/sistema
- https://royal.app.br/sistema/pms-hotelaria
- https://royal.app.br/sistema/sistema-para-hoteis
- https://royal.app.br/sistema/sistema-para-pousadas
- https://royal.app.br/sistema/manutencao-hotelaria
- https://royal.app.br/sistema/governanca-hotelaria
- https://royal.app.br/sistema/eventos-hotelaria
- https://royal.app.br/sistema/financeiro-hotelaria

Core modules:
- Reservations and reception
- Housekeeping
- Maintenance tickets, live board, pending parts and preventive maintenance
- Events, leads, quotes and service orders
- Finance, invoices, corporate clients and documents
- Marketing, direct booking and operational visibility

The hotel website remains at https://royal.app.br/. Operational PMS routes, maintenance boards, QR/report pages and authenticated dashboards should not be indexed.
